title: q-fuzzy-equivalence
description: The Q-enriched analogue of categorical equivalence: a pair of Q-functors whose round-trip compositions agree with the identity up to a quantale-graded error q. Generated by relating two quantale-enriched sheaves with quantale-graded slack.

grade.description: q in Q, the quantale element bounding the round-trip error; q = 1 (quantale unit) gives strict equivalence, q < 1 gives fuzzy equivalence

unit-bound.description: hom_C(GF(x), x) >= q and hom_C(x, GF(x)) >= q for all x in ob(C)

counit-bound.description: hom_D(FG(y), y) >= q and hom_D(y, FG(y)) >= q for all y in ob(D)

composes-multiplicatively.description: C ~=_p D and D ~=_q E yield C ~=_{p.q} E; fuzziness is the product of component grades
